purpose: Repair and qualify the real Live semantic-fulfillment interface discovered by the Codex diagnostic, while preserving fail-closed semantic safety and integrating only after qualification onto current I4H Recovery R3.
research_questions: Can Judge Prompt/Payload/Validator alignment eliminate contract-invalid cross-group evidence packets without weakening contradiction, omission, unsupported-invention, or missing-evidence rejection?
Can the exact prior Live failure be preserved as a deterministic regression fixture rather than overwritten or post-hoc repaired?

Can a fresh Live case traverse EPISODE_TO_SEQUENCE semantic fulfillment with a valid judge packet and, when obligations are actually fulfilled, reach SCENE_PLAN with complete provider/retrieval receipts?
If a valid judge finds genuine semantic omissions, does the engine distinguish VALID_SEMANTIC_HOLD from JUDGE_INVALID instead of misreporting all obligations as unfulfilled?

hypotheses.H1: Explicit per-obligation allowed_evidence_ids and same-group-only instructions produce zero POSITIVE_JUDGMENT_CROSS_GROUP_EVIDENCE invalid packets in deterministic and fresh Live qualification.
hypotheses.H2: Critical contradiction, omission, unsupported invention, unknown evidence IDs, empty-evidence positive judgments, and mixed-group evidence gaming remain fail-closed.
hypotheses.H3: The frozen prior Live output remains HOLD under the old interface and is never rewritten as PASS; under treatment it is used only as a no-network regression fixture.
hypotheses.H4: Invalid-judge reporting no longer equates packet invalidity with literary failure of every obligation; raw judge counts and validated semantic counts remain separate.
hypotheses.H5: Current I4H Recovery R3 remains byte-stable outside the authorized semantic alignment delta.
hypotheses.H6: DB59/RFV2 remains frozen and the engine track makes no DB64 adoption claim.
hypotheses.H7: A fresh Live case uses real OpenAI receipts; if the valid semantic contract accepts, execution reaches SCENE_PLAN. A valid semantic HOLD remains HOLD.

control.C0: Frozen current I4H Recovery R3 with no semantic candidate activated.
control.C1_regression_fixture: Exact Codex Live diagnostic output replay under archived Candidate R3 interface; historical expected result remains HOLD/JUDGE_INVALID; no network/output mutation.

treatment: Current I4H Recovery R3 plus a new isolated Semantic Contract Alignment Delta. Archived Candidate R2/R3 code is source material, not authority.
authorized_change_scope: judge payload contract adds obligation_group and allowed_evidence_ids
judge instructions require fulfilled=true evidence_ids to be non-empty subset of allowed_evidence_ids; cross-group references forbidden
judge schema/preflight changes only as needed to support the frozen payload contract
reporting separates JUDGE_INVALID from VALID_SEMANTIC_HOLD and does not convert invalid packets into literary unfulfilled_count=all
integration wiring to layer qualified semantic contract after current I4H Recovery R3 in a new delta
forbidden_change_scope: post-hoc editing prior Live evidence IDs
automatic semantic retry to cherry-pick PASS
deterministic_pre_live_tests: valid negative accepted as negative not judge-invalid
legacy scripted exact-match compatibility where authorized
invalid judge reporting separates raw and validated counts
exact frozen Codex failure replay reproducible without network

fresh_live_selection_rule.selection: Deterministic pre-output selection from DB59-eligible target works after 9/9 parent verification; algorithm and resulting work/episode/source-cutoff receipt sealed before first provider generation response.

decision_policy.PASS: All deterministic/regression/integrity gates pass and fresh Live has contract-valid receipts; new physical promotion additionally requires accepted hierarchy to reach SCENE_PLAN.
decision_policy.VALID_SEMANTIC_HOLD: Judge packet valid but obligations genuinely unfulfilled; preserve HOLD, no promotion/retry.
decision_policy.INFRA_HOLD: Transport/runtime failure after first Live response; preserve receipts, no cherry-pick retry.
decision_policy.PREOUTPUT_BLOCK: Credential/runtime failure before first generation response; not scored as Live attempt.

database_track_boundary: DB64/9-Contract candidate qualification is separate and subsequent. DB59 is frozen during this experiment.
physical_delivery_rule: If qualification changes any 5-Part/9-Package content, every changed transport package must be physically rebuilt/audited/delivered in the same closed cycle before new physical authority is declared. Byte-identical unchanged packages need not be regenerated.
